{{Quote|We are en route to intercept a Republic cruiser carrying supplies and reinforcements to the Foundry.|Moff Phennir|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
Around [[3642 BBY]], in the first days of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Republic forces had freed the notorious [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. Revan went to the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]], an ancient Rakatan space station, to create a droid army to annihilate the Empire.

Preparing for an [[Battle of the Foundry|upcoming assault]] on the Foundry, the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class Dreadnaught]] [[White Nova (Harrower-class)|''White Nova'']] ambushed the ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'', a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]] that was carrying supplies and troops to the space station. Once captured by the ''White Nova''{{'s}} tractor beam, an Imperial strike team entered the warship and captured it after eliminating the Republic forces in command of it. The ship would be later used to bypass the Republic blockade and board the Foundry prior to the arrival of the ''White Nova'' and the rest of the Imperial task force.

==The attack==
{{Quote|We will immobilize the cruiser with a tractor beam. You shall lead the boarding party.|Moff Phennir, to an Imperial operative|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
An Imperial strike team, supported by [[Imperial soldier|Imperial troopers]], entered the ''Dorin's Sky'' via an airlock. They fought through [[Republic trooper]]s, [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as they moved through the decks of the vessel toward the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. In the process they defeated the [[HXI-54 Juggernaut]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alvena]] and her supporting combat droids, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Sakan Do'nair and a pair of [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Menerus]].

During the battle, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yelto]], commanding the ship, realized that her troops would not be victorious and triggered the self-destruct. Forced to hurry, the strike team engaged [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] [[Kels]] in the reactor control room, defeating him and his power droids, before reaching the bridge. The bridge was defended by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jorland]] and a squadron of supporting troops. Despite utilizing a [[personal energy shield]], Jorland was killed and the strike team took control of the ship.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Once you have the cruiser and begin your attack on the Foundry, we will engage the Republic directly.|Moff Phennir|<ref name="TOR:CtA" />}}
{{GameDSmechanics}}
With the ''Dorin's Sky'' under their control, the strike team ordered Imperial troopers to execute all remaining crew.
{{Endgame}}

The Empire then provided a new crew for the ship and continued onward to the Foundry.

==Behind the scenes==
The Attack on the Dorin's Sky represents the events of Flashpoint: Boarding Party in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. This flashpoint is available only to Imperial players.
